info.title: x402 Trust: trust & reliability data for the x402 ecosystem
info.description: Trust and reliability scores for x402 endpoints from continuous 24/7 monitoring: uptime probes, 402-envelope compliance, advertised price history, and real on-chain USDC settlement volume per payTo address. Deterministic and auditable: know before you pay.
info.x-guidance: We monitor every publicly listed x402 endpoint 24/7: uptime probes, 402-envelope compliance, price history, and real on-chain USDC settlement volume per payTo address. Buy a trust score before paying an unknown endpoint. Payment: USDC EIP-3009 on Base mainnet (eip155:8453) via the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

get.description: Three complete trust reports (best, median, and worst of the current population), exactly as POST /v1/x402-trust returns them. No parameters.

200.description: Trust preview (3 full sample reports: best/median/worst)

post.description: Same as GET /v1/x402-trust-preview: three full sample reports, no parameters.

post.summary: Trust score for any x402 endpoint (cataloged or not)
post.description: Deterministic trust score (0-100, grade A-F) from 30d uptime, 402-envelope compliance, latency, age, on-chain USDC settlement activity, and price stability, with full breakdown and machine-readable flags. Uncataloged endpoints are live-probed on first query and auto-adopted.

resource.description: Full x402 resource URL (https://...) as listed in discovery.

$schema.description: Canonical URL of this response's JSON Schema (see /schemas/).

providerVerified.description: Present and true when the provider proved domain control + confirmed contact email.

providerContact.description: Provider contact email, published after confirmation (verified providers only).

breakdown.description: Per-component subscores (uptime, compliance, latency, age, activity, stability).

stats.description: Raw 30d stats the score was computed from.

post.summary: Observation history for any listed x402 endpoint
post.description: Raw time-series from our monitoring database: listing and delisting events, price and payTo changes, and probe results for the requested window. This is the data nobody can backfill: we were watching, you weren't.

resource.description: Full x402 resource URL (https://...) as listed in discovery.

post.summary: Find better-scored alternatives to an x402 endpoint
post.description: Semantically similar endpoints that currently out-score a given one, for routing away from a mediocre endpoint toward a more reliable one serving the same function. Same-host siblings and avoid-flagged endpoints are excluded; an empty list means nothing beats the subject.

resource.description: Full x402 resource URL (https://...) as listed in discovery.

minScoreDelta.description: Minimum trust-score advantage an alternative must have over the subject (default 5).

alternatives.description: Ranked array: resource, score, grade, recommendation, similarity, amountUsd, network, endpointPage.

post.summary: Semantic search over the x402 catalog
post.description: Meaning-based search: describe the capability you need in plain words, get the up to 25 closest endpoints ranked by cosine similarity, then trust score. Discovery only: no verdicts or flags (POST /v1/x402-trust carries those). Per-IP rate limited (429 on excess).

query.description: Free-text search query (2-500 chars). Describe the capability you need in plain words.

200.description: query + count + ranked matches (id, resource, score, grade, similarity, description, endpointPage; score/grade null when unscored)

503.description: embedding service or similarity index unavailable, retry shortly

post.summary: Watch one x402 endpoint for 30 days (change + liveness alerts)
post.description: Monitor one listed endpoint for 30 days: alerts on payTo, price, asset or network changes, spec regressions, delisting, and liveness. Push to signed HTTPS webhooks or Slack/Discord URLs (max 5 each), connection-tested before payment. Returns a one-time bearer secret plus poll, edit, and cancel URLs.

endpoint.description: Full x402 resource URL (https://...) as listed in discovery.

events.description: Optional event types to subscribe to (default all): payto_change, price_change, asset_network_change, spec_regression, delisting, liveness_down, liveness_recovered.

liveness_sensitivity_n.description: Consecutive missed probes before a liveness_down is surfaced (1=paranoid … 10=relaxed; default 2).

delivery.description: Optional push delivery { webhook_url(s), slack_url(s) } (https public hosts, max 5 each). Each accepts a single URL string or an array. webhook_url(s) = signed HTTPS webhook; verify `x-signature` = 'sha256=' + HMAC-SHA256(body) keyed by hex(sha256(secret)) (NOT raw secret). slack_url(s) = Slack or Discord incoming webhook. All URLs are connection-tested before you're charged. Polling is always available.

watch_id.description: Opaque watch id (used in the poll/renew/edit/cancel URLs).

secret.description: One-time bearer secret (wsk_…); only its hash is stored. Store it now.

poll_url.description: GET this with Authorization: Bearer <secret> to read events.

renew_url.description: POST here with payment to extend the watch; the secret stays the same.

edit_url.description: PATCH here (bearer-authed, free) to change delivery URLs/sensitivity/events.

cancel_url.description: DELETE here (bearer-authed, free) to cancel the watch early.

expires_at.description: Unix ms when the watch expires (renew to extend).

watched.description: The endpoint(s) covered by this watch.

subscribed_events.description: Event types the watch is subscribed to, or 'all'.

liveness_sensitivity_n.description: Consecutive misses before liveness_down is surfaced to you.

delivery.description: Enabled push channels + connection_test results (poll is always true).

get.description: Two append-only streams: events (endpoint changes) and watch_events (lifecycle feedback). Auth: Authorization: Bearer <secret>. Page with since = next_cursor and watch_since = watch_events_cursor; nothing is lost between polls.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Endpoint-event cursor (next_cursor). Omit or 0 for all.

parameters.name: watch_since
parameters.description: Lifecycle-event cursor (watch_events_cursor). Omit or 0 for all.

patch.description: Change a watch's webhook or Slack URLs, liveness sensitivity, or subscribed events. New URLs are connection-tested first; if any fails, the existing config stays unchanged. Delivery fields are full-replace per channel.

events.description: Optional event types to subscribe to (default all).

delivery.description: { webhook_url(s), slack_url(s) } — full replace per channel; max 5 each.

delete.description: Soft-cancel the watch immediately; the event log stays readable until expiry. Idempotent.

post.summary: Renew a watch 30 more days (same key)
post.description: Extend an existing watch by 30 days. The bearer secret stays the same; renewing early adds time from the later of now or the current expiry.

key_unchanged.description: Always true — the secret is not rotated.

post.summary: Bulk trust score for up to 10 endpoints
post.description: Score up to 10 x402 endpoints in one call. Found rows carry the full trust report identical to POST /v1/x402-trust, served from cached snapshots (no live re-probe; for that use /v1/x402-trust). Unknown resources return found:false; if none are tracked the request is rejected with 400 notCharged:true. Price: $0.045000 per call.

resources.description: List of full x402 resource URLs. Max 10; fewer allowed; duplicates ignored.

generated_at.description: Unix ms when the response was generated.

results.description: One result per requested resource, in request order. Each found:true row is the full trust report (same fields as POST /v1/x402-trust: score, grade, scoreRange, recommendation, confidenceDetail, breakdown, subscores, explanations, flags, flagsDetailed, advertised, stats) plus the bulk provenance fields (found, endpoint_id, probes_30d, probed_at, computed_at, recomputed).
